title: 第2章 真实的阶级

content_zh:
这是一片围绕着一座半城山而建的一片住宅区，顺着那条有着铁栅栏的道路往前走，一直走到小路的尽头就是莫凡家了。
矮矮的一小栋，一层半高，外漆已经斑驳露出红砖，周围有很多杂物。
街坊邻居的房子基本上都有三层半了，经过了一番装修翻新之后显得更像是一个家，而本身就最角落又低矮的莫凡家就显得格外寒酸老旧。
“莫凡哥，回来了啊……我给你带了个好消息咧。”刚到家门口，一个跟泥猴子一样的少年就跳了出来，满脸喜悦的说道。
这泥猴子叫张候，也是这片老街区的孩子，算是和莫凡一起长大的。
“什么好消息？”莫凡问了一句。
“小公主回来咯，我今天在山庄门口看见她了，哇塞，你不知道现在小公主长得多漂亮，简直就是小天使。”张小候有些小激动的说道。
莫凡看了一眼这条街迎面着的山庄。山庄是一片精致到令整个城市都羡慕的绿化，每一寸土地的花草树木都经过了精心的雕琢，达到真正园林的级别。
不过，这漂亮的城山园林此时是被高铁栏给围了起来。
记得小时候，铁栅栏是没有的，自己经常带着这条街的孩子们在这座山庄庄园内玩闹。
山庄最高处有好几栋非常精致的欧式别墅，在他们这群熊孩子眼中就跟童话故事里的城堡一样，而城堡里也确实住着一个美丽得让人忘记呼吸的公主，和他们年龄差不多，莫凡经常带着一群小孩把公主拐带出来一起到处玩耍……
可不知什么时候，山庄多了铁栅栏，街道的大人们都不允许孩子再闯到山庄里去，而那位原本和大家玩成一片的公主就真的成为了城堡里的公主，随着年龄的增长变得遥不可及，见到的次数越来越少了。
“你知道吗，我听说小公主现在是帝都名校魔法尖子，天生对冰系魔法有着别人无法媲美的能力，才15岁就已经可以释放冰系魔法了。”张候神神秘秘的说道。
莫凡愣了愣，假如张候跟自己说小公主获得什么全国奥赛奖这些，他估计毫无感觉，但如果是冰系魔法师的话，那就真的了不得了！
绝大多数人都是要到16岁，也就是高一的时候才接受觉醒，获得自己的第一系魔法。
获得之后并不意味着你就是魔法师，你还需要经过非常漫长的修炼，还需要获得魔法书、勤加练习才能够释放出一个魔法来，这个小公主可真了不得，15岁就已经是真正的魔法师了！
难道这就是所谓的神童？魔法界的神童！
“莫凡哥，我好替你可惜啊，当年你再加把劲没准就把天真无邪的小公主给拿下了。才貌双全，啧啧啧……羡慕死我们了。”张小候挑着眉毛说道。
“那小时候的屁事，说个毛线。”莫凡没理会他。
莫家兴听着这两个少年说这种话，咳嗽了一声，托着莫凡回家去了。

刚回到家，爸爸莫家兴就道：“我出去一会，心夏在姨姨那住，应该不会回来。”
“好，我知道了。”
莫家兴步伐匆忙的离开了，莫凡在家走了一圈，发现家里其实并没有任何的变化，一样的家徒四壁。
世界都变了，但家庭的穷酸一点都没有变，怎么自己家庭没和山庄上那户人家调换一下，老天爷也真是的大费周章的将科学搞成魔法，难道这点小事都不顺便一下。
唯一还值得庆幸的是：自己样貌没变，依然风流倜傥！
在家坐着也无聊，什么东西都没有，莫凡无聊下出去逛了一圈，想看看其他东西是否发生了变化。
顺着很少人走的苔藓小道，刚要拐到大街，莫凡正好看到自己老爸的老皮卡车。
老爸是司机，以前是给山庄上面的老爷开车的，后来不知道怎么的调到后勤去了，基本上去帮山庄上面的人采购东西，从那以后家庭和状况急剧下降。
“家兴啊，你这样的要求就有些无礼了。你该知道我以前也对你们不薄，你们家小子做出那样的事，我还留了一个采购给你做，换作是别人家我就直接让他卷铺盖走人了。”一个中年男子语气缓慢的声音传了出来。
“穆贺哥，就当我是最后一次找你帮忙，天澜魔法高中买进去的话真的要太多钱了，我家的情况您也是了解的，实在负担不起。”莫家兴显得有些低声下气的声音慢慢的传来。

content_en:
This is a residential area built around a half-city mountain. Walk along the road with the iron fence until you reach the end of the path, which is Mo Fan's house.
It was a short building, one and a half stories high. The exterior paint was mottled and the red bricks were exposed. There were a lot of debris around it.
Most of the houses in the neighborhood have three and a half floors. After some decoration and renovation, they look more like a home. However, Mo Fan's house, which is the most corner and low-rise, looks particularly shabby and old.
"Brother Mo Fan, you're back... I have good news for you." As soon as he arrived at the door of his house, a boy who looked like a clay monkey jumped out and said with joy on his face.
This mud monkey's name is Zhang Hou, and he is also a child from this old neighborhood. He grew up with Mo Fan.
"What good news?" Mo Fan asked.
"The little princess is back. I saw her at the gate of the villa today. Wow, you don't know how beautiful the little princess looks now. She is like a little angel." Zhang Xiaohou said with some excitement.
Mo Fan glanced at the villa facing this street. The villa is a piece of greenery that is so exquisite that the entire city would envy it. The flowers, plants and trees on every inch of the land have been carefully carved to the level of a real garden.
However, this beautiful Chengshan Garden is now surrounded by high-speed iron fences.
I remember that when I was a child, there were no iron fences, and I often took the children from this street to play in this mountain manor.
There are several very exquisite European-style villas at the top of the villa. In the eyes of these naughty children, they are just like castles in fairy tales. In the castle, there is indeed a princess who is so beautiful that people can forget to breathe. She is about the same age as them. Mo Fan often leads a group of children to abduct the princess and play around together...
But at some point, iron fences were added to the villa, and the adults on the street did not allow children to break into the villa anymore. The princess who used to play with everyone really became the princess in the castle. As she grew older, she became out of reach, and she was seen less and less often.
"You know, I heard that the little princess is now the top magician in a prestigious school in the imperial capital. She is born with an ability to use ice magic that no one else can match. She can already cast ice magic at the age of 15." Zhang Hou said mysteriously.
Mo Fan was stunned. If Zhang Hou had told him what kind of National Olympiad the little princess had won, he would probably have no idea at all. But if it was an ice magician, that would be really amazing!
Most people don't accept awakening until they are 16 years old, that is, their first year of high school, and obtain their first line of magic.
Obtaining it does not mean that you are a magician. You still need to go through a very long period of practice. You also need to obtain a magic book and practice diligently before you can release a magic. This little princess is really amazing. She is already a real magician at the age of 15!
Is this the so-called prodigy? A prodigy in the wizarding world!
"Brother Mo Fan, I feel so sorry for you. If you had worked harder back then, you might have captured the innocent little princess. She is both talented and beautiful, tsk tsk tsk... I'm so jealous of us." Zhang Xiaohou said with raised eyebrows.
"Just tell me what happened when I was a kid." Mo Fan ignored him.
Mo Jiaxing coughed when he heard these two teenagers saying such things, and took Mo Fan back home.
As soon as he got home, his father, Mo Jiaxing, said, "I'm going out for a while. Xinxia is staying at my aunt's place, so she probably won't come back."
"Okay, I get it."
Mo Jiaxing left in a hurry. Mo Fan walked around the house and found that there was no change in the house. It was the same with the same walls.
The world has changed, but the poverty of the family has not changed at all. Why hasn't my family changed with the family in the villa? God has really spent a lot of time to turn science into magic. Isn't this a small thing just a small thing?
The only thing worth celebrating is: sinceHis appearance has not changed, he is still charming and suave!
Sitting at home was boring and there was nothing. Mo Fan went out for a walk out of boredom to see if other things had changed.
Following the mossy path that few people walked, Mo Fan happened to see his father's old pickup truck when he was about to turn onto the street.
My father is a driver. He used to drive for the boss of the villa. Later, for some reason, he was transferred to the logistics department. He basically helped the people in the villa purchase things. Since then, the family and his situation have declined sharply.
"Jia Xing, your request is a bit rude. You should know that I was not kind to you before. If your boy did something like that, I would leave a purchase for you. If it were someone else's house, I would just let him pack up and leave." A middle-aged man's slow voice came out.
"Brother Mu He, just think that this is the last time I ask you for help. It will really cost too much money to buy Tianlan Magic High School. You also know the situation of my family. I really can't afford it." Mo Jiaxing's voice sounded a little groveling slowly.
